issue.title: Fix monitor follow-up output excerpts and host PATH loss in agent-shell launches
issue.description: Monitor follow-up prompts show the real tail of the monitored command's output, and agents launched from inside an agent's harness shell (monitor follow-ups, handoffs, nested launches) resolve provider CLIs with the same PATH a host launch would have.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/monitor_followup_output_and_host_path.md requests this work

issue.title: Show the real output tail in monitor follow-up prompts
issue.description: monitor-output-tail: populate retained-log segment ranges when no retention snapshot exists, read legacy null-range metadata, and excerpt the tail rather than the head.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/monitor_followup_output_and_host_path.md defines phase monitor-output-tail as one work unit

issue.title: Restore the host PATH for agent launches made from agent shells
issue.description: host-path-launch-env: runners stamp a SASE_HOST_PATH_SNAPSHOT of their PATH and spawn_agent_subprocess restores it, so login-shell PATH resets cannot hide provider CLIs.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/monitor_followup_output_and_host_path.md defines phase host-path-launch-env as one work unit

payload.entry: LANDING AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Read the epic, both children, every child note, approved plan plan:202610/monitor_followup_output_and_host_path.md, and commits def4c66ce3 (sase-1nk.1) and ed321c5434 (sase-1nk.2). Host-first deduplicated PATH restoration is after hygiene and before explicit extra_env; runner main stamps the snapshot; proc supervisor PATH is unchanged. Active/rotated fallback ranges, legacy null-range reads, and reverse tail selection are present. Refreshed origin/master: since epic creation and since first epic commit there are only these two epic commits, so no integration drift. No epic-symbol entries; no parent_bead link. Remaining scope: phase monitor-output-tail explicitly required an end-to-end proc-backed settlement-to-composed-prompt regression, but current settlement tests replace launch_followup_agent and the new tail test calls frozen_output_text directly. Plan a small tale to add this coverage, fix any epic-owned defect it exposes, verify, and finish this epic closeout in the coder turn. Focused pytest audit could not collect because this workspace venv lacks sase_core_rs; no new passing test claim. PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP outcomes: sase-1nk.1 note #1 and sase-1nk.2 note #1 are one import-budget issue, corroborated on existing ready task sase-1ic via /sase_new_task. Declined two new tasks because they duplicate that existing node/remediation; reviewed recent CI tasks and active epics, with no credible causal active-epic link. Phase reports independently show clean-base 3529 vs 3527, unrelated to this epic. The transient failures mentioned in completion notes passed focused reruns per those notes; they add no distinct proposal.

Landing complete for sase-1nk.

Implementation commits reviewed: def4c66ce3 (sase-1nk.1: proc-backed retained-log ranges, legacy null-range reads, tail excerpts) and ed321c5434 (sase-1nk.2: SASE_HOST_PATH_SNAPSHOT plus host-first restore on nested launches). Preserved reviewer decisions path_merge_order=host_first and monitored_command_path=no; monitored commands keep the spawning shell PATH.

Added tests/monitor/test_monitor_proc_settlement_followup_prompt.py: real settle_monitor_artifacts freeze/persist, then launch_followup_agent/compose_followup_prompt, capturing the prompt at spawn. Oversized failed log with early sentinel and final fail summary; live log poisoned after freeze so capture fallback cannot pass. Result: the Last-N section contains FAIL_SUMMARY/# fail 5, omits the early sentinel and CAPTURE_FALLBACK_SENTINEL, and has no retained-output gap. Focused pytest: 50 passed (new regression, diagnostics/tail, launch-env, env-hygiene, runner-bootstrap).

Drift: refreshed origin/master still ed321c5434; no intervening commits since the epic pair. Epic-symbols: none.
